title: ban appeal

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Your other appeals were already denied, and we had clear evidence at the time of your hacked client. Fly and Speed do not occur as a result of 'lag', so next time explain what happened truthfully. Please do not create another appeal until you're able to do this in detail.

Regards,
Mango_
